rationale: A final certificate reports a metric subject to a maintenance covenant, and the analyst has not completed the documented calculation.

observed_fact.description: Borrower delivered its final quarterly compliance certificate. It reports Total Net Leverage of 5.8x for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
observed_fact.source: Borrower-signed compliance certificate received through the agent bank portal

agreement_terms.definitions: Total Net Leverage and permitted cash netting are defined in the executed agreement. The full calculation worksheet is attached to the case file.
agreement_terms.cure_right: The executed agreement includes an equity cure right; no cure has been asserted.
agreement_terms.status: Current executed agreement; no later amendment or waiver located

policy.covenant_test: Run the documented covenant calculation when a final certificate reports a maintenance covenant metric.
policy.borrower_follow_up: Request missing, unclear, internally inconsistent, or late information needed to complete the test.
policy.counsel_review: Route questions about interpretation, enforceability, notice, waiver, default, or cure rights to counsel.
policy.credit_review: Escalate a verified breach, material deterioration, or a policy-defined risk trigger to credit.
policy.no_action: Use only when the fact does not require one of these actions under the supplied agreement and policy.
